purpose: Decide whether audience interest and measured operator effort justify a second month.
threshold_basis: Provisional operating hurdles chosen before results, not platform benchmarks or a powered statistical test. Freeze any edits before the first post.

rules.go: Coverage, attention, usefulness, comprehension and production-time gates all pass; no unresolved recurring critical misunderstanding. Continue for one bounded month, not an unlimited commitment.
rules.no_go: Adequate observations show both attention and useful-response gates failed, or measured production remains above the chosen capacity after one documented simplification. Report evidence and the failed condition; this rejects the current format, not all possible fitness content.
rules.iterate: Mixed evidence or one repairable clarity/production problem. Choose one documented change and one bounded follow-up; do not indefinitely extend a failing pilot.
rules.insufficient_evidence: Too few mature posts, too little exposure, missing metrics, unmeasured labor or missing comprehension checks. Do not convert missing observations into zeros. Allow one additional 14-day observation/distribution window, without buying reach or changing the success rule. If still insufficient, decide whether the unresolved distribution problem merits further investment.

organic_comparison: Eight question-led and eight answer-led openings, balanced within week and weekday. The broader topic mix is not balanced by pillar. Organic comparison is descriptive, not randomized or causal.
posting_slot: 18:00 America/New_York is a scheduling convenience, not a claimed optimal time. Use the same slot initially. Dates are a proposal until actual publication receipts exist.
privacy: Only aggregate observations belong in Git. Use pseudonymous participant IDs; keep contact mappings private. No unsolicited recruitment or publishing has been authorized.
capacity_source: User selected up to 12 hands-on hours per week on 2026-10-21
controls: One scheduled version per BP episode; citation and motion controls are not extra posts.
Eight Q and eight A openings balanced by week and weekday, not by the new uneven content pillars.
Same chosen brand, approved voice, caption style, upload slot and master on both platforms.
Record duration, topic, traffic source, follower mix where available, corrections and distribution interventions.
No paid reach, engagement purchases or deletion of weak posts to improve the summary.
Preserve first-168-hour platform exports and missing-value reasons.
Keep prior versions and platform denominators separate; label this cohort v5-blueprint.
comparison_analysis: At the full-cohort readout report counts, exposure range, episode-level STW/APV and group medians by hook and cluster. Do not declare a winner if group coverage differs substantially; do not compute a causal lift or p-value from these sixteen organic posts. Log topic, duration and traffic source as competing explanations.

sustainability_experiment.measure: Start/stop hands-on time for research, scripts, claim review, visuals, audio review, corrections, posting, community and measurement. Machine wait time separate.
sustainability_experiment.setup: Record this research/rebuild as setup work, separately from recurring production. Agent wall time is not observed owner labor.
sustainability_experiment.prebuilt_month_warning: Publishing a prebuilt archive alone does not measure the cost of creating four new videos. Measure at least two representative four-video production/revision batches, or retain INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for recurring production.
simplification_order: Remove optional visual variants and decorative revision
If still above capacity, propose a lower cadence as a new bounded protocol; do not call the original cadence sustainable.

freeze_rule: Freeze Blueprint scripts, calendar, identity and operating hurdles before the first BP-series post.
interpretation: No live observations. Earlier media are prototypes, not audience controls.
prelaunch_production_revision: Blueprint selected by owner. Eleven reviewed scripts retained; five new broader lifestyle episodes. New IDs isolate the cohort.

brand_screen.selection: Owner selected Blueprint; no comparative audience winner claimed.
brand_screen.test: Use inclusive adult beginners to test unaided category, main point, next action, source understanding and whether dream-body framing seems personal or prescriptive.
brand_screen.limits: Small usability screen, not proof of teen suitability or demographic effects.

motion_screen.stimulus: BP04 Blueprint motion versus static-interpolation control, matched narration, timing and source cues.
motion_screen.test: Fresh adult beginners see one version first; ask the takeaway and whether the walk example covers all activity needs. Preference only after first-exposure answers.
motion_screen.limit: Exploratory comprehension screen; no public-feed causal lift claim.

metrics_notes.youtube: Engaged views and first-168-hour stayed-to-watch/APV with platform definitions. Play-start views alone do not establish attention.
metrics_notes.instagram: Separate reach, views, watch-time fields actually available, saves, shares and useful responses. Do not fabricate a stayed-to-watch equivalent.
metrics_notes.diagnostics: Export all released episodes, including low exposure. Report eligible-only attention plus exposure ranges and missingness so the threshold does not hide distribution failure.
metrics_notes.decision: Thresholds retained as provisional operating hurdles, not platform norms or a powered sample size. Sensitivity reporting at nearby hurdles is descriptive; it cannot change the frozen primary decision.
